thread:
Maya: Anyone up for a quick 'stair + crimp circuits' lunchtime microchallenge tomorrow? 12:30, meet by the north stairwell. 10 flights up + 5 short crimp circuits, ~20 mins total :grimacing:
Sam: I'm in. Might swap two crimps for strict pull-ups so I don't yank my tendons :sweat_smile:
Kyle: Team relay? Less chance of turning into a floor nap :joy:
Alex: I'll bring chalk and a tiny first-aid kit. If it's pouring we can move to rooftop sprints or the empty conference hall for rows.
Jen: FYI north stair is usually clear but it's a fire exit — keep it brief and polite if anyone passes.
Maya: Good call. We'll keep it quick and courteous. Plan B = rooftop sprints. @Jen thanks for flagging.
FitBot: Reminder: log your activity in #health-challenges to get credit for the monthly leaderboard and swag.
Sam: Quick poll — who wants which: A) Stair + crimp circuits B) Pull-up swap C) Rooftop sprints D) I'm just the hype crew
Kyle: B
Alex: A
Jen: C (I'll cheer)
Maya: A
Sam: B (I guess I'm torn)
Kyle: Also can someone bring tape for fingers? My last session ended in a tiny blood medal :grimacing:
Maya: Tape + water noted. @Kyle are you okay to set up a phone for a quick stream so remote folks can watch/cheer?
Kyle: Yup happy to livestream — I'll prop it on my laptop and mute notifications.
Alex: I'll be the camera operator if Kyle needs hands. Promise not to narrate like a climbing podcast :innocent:
Maya: Cool. Majority is A (stair+crimps). See you 12:30 north stair. Bring water, chalk/tape if you have it. Short, fun, no hero moves :muscle:
Sam: :thumbsup: I'll grab tape and a roll of pre-wrap.
Jen: Wish I could join in person but remote cheer squad from the east coast :wave:
FitBot: Activity logged when someone posts a photo or a short note in #health-challenges. Optional but encouraged :trophy:
Maya: Ok everyone, small reminder — respect building rules. If security asks we'll move to Plan B. See ya tomorrow!
